content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-69. - Expert services.
content.summary:
The council may employ legal, engineering and other expert services in connection
               with any project herein authorized and with the authorization, issuance and sale of
               bonds.
(Code 1981, § 27-70; Ord. No. 551, § 25(E), 5-14-1964)
